race.comment: ROSANGELA (5) looks well placed back in grade. She's been tested against much stronger company and held up well, placing fresh at Seymour in a deep BM62 before an even effort in town. Way back in grade here and should go close. STARBURST (6) started at $5.50 last time and ran below expectations, finishing eighth and beaten 4 lengths at Sale over 1013m after being in contention on the bend. Can bounce back with the maiden win fresh a solid piece of form. WHITSON (8) settled well back then came home powerfully to score by 0.8 lengths over 1000m at this track last time out, making it three in a row over this route. Impossible to knock. ETERNAL JOY (10) was too good for a maiden field last start over 1000m at this track, scoring by 1.3 lengths. Heading the right way and looks capable of measuring up again.
